starttls.note: Server advertised STARTTLS, but client did not use it — session proceeded in plaintext despite encryption being available.

findings.title: TLS Finding
findings.description: No TLS detected — session in plaintext
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to TLS 1.2 or 1.3 and replace weak cipher suites.

findings.title: Certificate Finding
findings.recommendation: Ensure a valid, non-expired certificate is served.

findings.title: Cleartext AUTH LOGIN credentials exposed
findings.description: AUTH LOGIN transmits credentials Base64-encoded, not encrypted. Both username and password were captured in cleartext.
findings.recommendation: Enforce STARTTLS or implicit TLS before allowing AUTH; reject AUTH attempts on unencrypted connections.

findings.title: Session in Plaintext — No TLS Negotiated
findings.description: No TLS handshake was detected for this session. The server may not have advertised STARTTLS, or the client did not attempt the upgrade. All traffic including authentication credentials is transmitted in cleartext.
findings.recommendation: Enable and enforce STARTTLS or switch to an implicit-TLS port.
